text: 沿着那群人留下的新鲜足迹追踪很容易。足迹把你们带回附近一片洼地。你俯身望去，看见令人难过的一幕：一名女子被绑在树上，仿佛被钉在原地任狼宰割。
这似乎完全不像图苏蒂纳人的作风。她究竟做了什么？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 583
text: It is straightforward to follow the fresh tracks left by the group. They lead you back to a nearby hollow. Looking down into it, you see a pathetic sight—a woman tied to a tree, as if staked out for the wolves.
This seems wildly out of character for the Tsuut’ina. What can she have done?
